messages:
nina-sales: FinEdge POC update: customer says logs reach Datadog but trace links are missing and they're intermittently hitting 429s. Also flagged a Q in the security questionnaire about storing PII in logs. Need quick triage and an ask to product about temporary burst increase + guidance on redaction.

jordan-eng: Thanks. Two separate threads: (1) trace linking - likely header propagation or sampling mismatch, (2) 429s - rate-limiting either at our drain or Datadog intake. Can we get a sample raw log (not processed)? Prefer multi-line with raw headers.

sam-se: They pasted a raw line: `ts=2026-03-19T08:12:11Z level=info req_id=abc123 TRACEID=00f1a2b3 path=/v1/charge user.email=alice@finedge.com` The key is TRACEID vs standard `traceparent` or `x-datadog-trace-id`. If forwarder maps TRACEID -> trace id correctly it can link, otherwise Datadog won't.

lee-ops: On our side: confirm the drain doesn't normalize or mangle header names. We've seen transforms rename `TRACEID` to `trace-id` which downstream agents ignore. Also check sampling settings; Datadog may be dropping traces if `span_rate` low.

security-bot: Security questionnaire note: "Do you redact PII from logs before export?" Answer: For Private deployments, PII redaction is customer-managed but we provide templates and a mutating transform that can remove keys matching `email|ssn|card`. If they want us to run transforms, need signed DPA.

nina-sales: Customer asked about cost of temporary burst increase during POC. Jordan, can you confirm pricing delta for a 48h bump?

jordan-eng: For POCs we usually offer a free short bump (<=72h) for evaluation. I'll open a platform ticket if infra approves. Meanwhile, suggest they enable local batching and reduce flush frequency to avoid hitting intake. Example config for their Go forwarder: `batch_max_bytes: 8192; flush_interval_ms: 500`

sam-se: Also tell them to publish trace headers in structured JSON rather than embedded in a single string. Eg: `headers: {"traceparent":"00-...","x-request-id":"..."}`. That avoids brittle parsers.

lee-ops: infra-bot: creating PLAT ticket to bump drain burst for org FinEdge for 48h.

infra-bot: PLAT-7899 created by lee-ops: TEMP_BURST_FINEDGE - requested 48h burst increase. Est ETA: 90m.

jordan-eng: Quick debug steps for customer: 1) add `/debug/headers` endpoint to confirm what arrives at forwarder, 2) ensure forwarder maps `TRACEID` -> `traceparent` or `x-datadog-trace-id`, 3) enable batching + backoff, 4) mask PII fields via transform or local redaction. Provide them snippet: `transform:\n  - remove_keys: ["user.email", "user.card_number"]\n  - rename_keys: {"TRACEID":"traceparent"}`

sam-se: If after header mapping they still don't see links, we should check our console routing rules for that org -- sometimes we re-route logs through a collector that strips custom header fields. I can pre-check routing for FinEdge org id 6789.

nina-sales: Customer redeploying now; will paste `GET /debug/headers` output here. Also they want an explicit note for the security questionnaire: "PII redaction supported via transforms; no PII left in our platform for Private POCs by default." I'll draft that answer and post.

lee-ops: One gotcha we've seen: Datadog will not associate logs->traces unless the trace id is numeric and matches their internal sampling rules. If their TRACEID is hex + length diff, we need to translate. Sam, can you add a small helper mapping?

sam-se: Yep. I'll prepare a tiny Go snippet to convert hex trace to Datadog trace id and share. Example: `func hexToDD(hex string) uint64 { v, _ := strconv.ParseUint(hex,16,64); return v }`

infra-bot: PLAT-7899 status: approved. Burst applied at 2026-03-19T09:40Z, expires in 48h.

nina-sales: Great. They posted `/debug/headers` output and it shows `TRACEID` present, but no `traceparent`. They also show 429 timestamps matching our drain. Next: ask them to apply rename transform and redeploy.

jordan-eng: After they redeploy, check Datadog logs for `dd.trace_id` field, and then try search with the converted numeric id. If still missing, escalate to onboarding for a short remote debug session.

nina-sales: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate with the customer on redaction language and share the Go helper. Will update when they finish deploy. :balloon:
